sketches.mechanism: A weak reference does not retain its object and is automatically set to nil after the only strong reference leaves scope.
sketches.resonance: Memory that refuses to hold tightly becomes an empty place as soon as the living presence departs.

sketches.mechanism: An exception variable bound by an except clause is deleted after the clause finishes.
sketches.resonance: Grief can be named only while it is being handled; afterward even the name is taken away.

sketches.mechanism: Erlang variables are single-assignment; a later “assignment” is a pattern match that fails if the value differs.
sketches.resonance: A truth may be repeated, but it cannot be revised without breaking the process.
